HOPI:-

Patient was appatently asymptomatic 3years back.He developed pain abdomen and vomitings for which he was diagnosed as acute pancreatitis at private hospital at nalgonda sanjeevani hospital, was admitted for 3days and subsided and got discharged. After 7 months he came to KIMS narketpally and got treated for some and got discharged at request and went to other hospital. patient came with abdominal discomfort and vomitings on aug 20 morning 8am

Past history:-

 Is a known case of Dm is on Rx since 10-12years

Rx - T Glim m1 and T voglibose and glim m1

Is not a known case of HTN/CAD/Epilepsy
